item.title: Abu Dhabi will put water investment on the UN agenda for the first time since 2023
item.description: The UN Water Conference opens in Abu Dhabi on December 8, the first UN water summit since 2023, with investment for water as one of its six dialogues. It ends with a President's summary, not a negotiated text, so the deals signed around it matter most.
